events.title: Star Party at Vintage Hills Elementary
events.description: Star Party for elementary and high schoolers. Set up between 5 and 5:30, and viewing will begin about 6. No moon but Saturn is up, Jupiter and the Orion nebula may sneak up enough before the event ends. Should be able to drive out to the viewing site. Please let me know if you can attend.
